slides.title: Category 7 leads adoption at 92%; the bottom three sit under half

exhibit.heading: Share of respondents adopting each practice

points.text: Three practices account for most of the gap to the leaders.
Each depends on a capability the firm has not built.
Its rollout playbook transfers to categories 1 to 3.

slides.soWhat: Fund the three lagging practices with the category 7 playbook before adding new ones.

slides.title: The market reaches $1.65B by 2030 on a 13% CAGR, led by enterprise

points.text: Two-thirds of the 2026 to 2028 increment is enterprise seats.
Pricing, not demand, gates the consumer segment.

points.lead: The 2030 figure assumes no price erosion
points.text: Every 5% of erosion removes $80M from the endpoint.
